# beast-civilization — llms-full.txt (v0.7.0 Compact Context Bundle)

## Summary
`beast-civilization v0.7.0` ("The Omniscient Hyper-Colony Release") is a zero-dependency polyglot bare-metal Agent Civilization, Live OpenAI/GGUF HTTP/1.1 Inference Server (`beast serve`), Post-Quantum Colony, Trinity Autonomous Forge (OS Microkernels + 4-Layer Chimera LLMs + Bare-Metal A-Life Worlds), MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 Server, & Evolutionary Compute Substrate unifying **Zig `0.17.1`**, **Rust `1.94.1` (8 crates, zero external Cargo crates)**, **CRuby `3.4.9`/Prism/YARV (zero gems)**, **C11 (`12 / 12` live native DLLs)**, **QEMU `11.1.0` Ring-0 booted AI microkernels**, **Win32 Kernel Job Objects**, **NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti `sm_12.0` 5-Kernel PTX + `20.21 GB/s` Pinned Async VRAM Paging**, **standard `llama.cpp` GGUF v3 `Q4_0`/`F16`/`F32`**, **Eshkol Tri-Mode AD (`0.00e0` err)**, **clean-room Python 3 exact oracle**, **AMS-LaTeX white paper (`dist/Donahue_2026_beast_civilization.pdf`)**, and **65 Pure Lean 4 `v4.35.0` Theorems (`lean/VerifyAxioms.lean`)** (`296 / 300 = 98.7%` agent matrix live-verified).

## Build & Verify
Run `.\build.ps1` (`33/33` gates, `38/38` planted mutants, `21/21` Rust unit tests, `65/65` Lean 4 proofs) and `python scripts/verify_independent_oracle.py`.
